may_reconcile.old: - [ ] Demonstrate a matched negative ecology where the advantage disappears.
- [ ] Obtain at least one result that is not merely a reconstruction of known architecture behavior.
- [ ] Result must be predicted before observation.
- [ ] Result must be surprising relative to at least one strong baseline/parent theory or expert expectation.
- [ ] Result must survive hostile controls and independent replication.
- [ ] Prefer one of: unseen morphology, unexpected phase transition, new capability/impossibility law, or one law spanning artificial and natural cognition.
- [ ] Demonstrate why the result changes how machine intelligence should be studied or designed.

must_stay_open.reason: independent replication is not self-suppliable: M5 has zero instances in this corpus and same-author routes never license it

out_of_scope.old: - [ ] Freeze a property-first prediction for an unobserved morphology from theory alone.
- [ ] Recover the candidate without its macro/property template being inserted into the search grammar.
- [ ] Perform strongest-parent reduction against all known relevant architecture families.
- [ ] Show a semantics/resource/developmental distinction not reducible to syntactic novelty.
- [ ] Predict the niche in which the candidate should dominate before testing.
- [ ] Claim W4/new-domain status only if the registered W4 criteria are actually met.
